originalAssessment.scale: 0 unusable in observed scope; 5 playable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional across assessed scope. Holistic judgment, not a win/loss grade or arithmetic average.

reasons.overallMobile: A coherent, atmospheric short mission with clear assisted progression, readable key controls and satisfying visible objective completion. Manual patrol aim/drag needed repeated correction and firing/cover feedback was initially hard to interpret. Both completions used substantial route, approach and shot assists; those wins do not certify unassisted combat quality.
reasons.controls: MOVE and FIRE worked together; turns, DASH cooldown and zoom were observable. Patrol aiming missed or failed to finish targets and first-run corrections were awkward. Coil selectors were effective. Continuous held-burst comfort remains unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, changing Custodian states, coil disabling and deck upload gave a complete objective arc. Visible danger and reload added demands, though route assistance carried much navigation and enemies could be left behind. Unassisted balance and broader content unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Distinct rainy teal industrial setting, reflective ground, large typography and consistent terminal treatment. Strong visual identity in software rendering; audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: HOLD ROUTE / HOLD APPROACH, explicit coil selectors, automatic reload and detailed assist accounting reduced uncertainty. Firing rearm/cover behavior and simultaneous threat overlays took learning. No menu/settings exploration beyond the visible opening screen.
reasons.readability: Main objective, ammo, health and touch controls legible at 844x390. World text and tiny distant enemies required attention; threat/interaction panels occupied useful scene space.

originalAssessment.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable limitations; 9 excellent; 10 exceptional across the assessed experience. Holistic judgments of observed portrait emulation, not calculated from wins or accuracy.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent short mission with strong feedback and accessible controls; limited free navigation and continuous-control evidence, cramped portrait combat view.
reasons.controls: Large FIRE, MOVE, AIM and DASH worked in sampled batches, including two-contact patrol combat. Zoom and drag are usable here, but pause lifecycle and contact releases prevent a real held-control comfort judgment.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, coils and uplink create understandable progression; patrol engagements and cover response observed. Heavy route/tap assistance and short paused bursts leave depth, tension and sustained enjoyment only partly assessed.
reasons.presentation: Consistent teal/amber visual identity, rainy industrial scene and polished title/result layout; some dark geometry and distant targets blend together. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Objective checkmarks, contextual HOLD labels, route lines, map legend, target-down and coil OFF feedback reduce uncertainty. Map closes visibly. No settings changes were needed.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and large controls are clear at 390x844. Small distant enemies, small status text, dark cover and stacked prompts reduce scene legibility.
